description: Scroll scribing (docs/draft/spell-scroll-system.md): a caster scribes a scroll of a spell they know at a station of their class's tradition. Cost is parchment + carried ink and pen + the spell's own material component + the gold and time below. Success = base + per_mod x casting-ability modifier, clamped to [min_chance, max_chance]. Failure spends everything but makes no scroll. Scroll items are generated at migrate for every spell up to max_spell_level that has no hand-written scroll; value = the tier's gold.
